events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, dying six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost an icon. Tupac Shakur's influence on hip-hop and culture remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Death
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27, in London.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: It's 56 years since we lost the legendary Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your go-to track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972, and turns 54 today.

angles.name: Rock'n'Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: A Song For Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First Apple iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Tech That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond theme song? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940. He would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. An incredible, diverse collection of tracks that still sounds fresh today.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45, from complications due to AIDS.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that marked a new direction for the band.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's Death
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40, in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world fell silent. We remember John Lennon, a true visionary whose legacy lives on.
